第一胎在家自己坐月子，每天半夜爬起来泡奶、喂奶、拍嗝，整个人烦躁又忧郁。第二胎果断选月子中心，完全颠覆我的想象——每天就是吃、喝、睡、挤奶，真的像贵妇住五星酒店。

护士随传随到，宝宝在房间有任何状况一叫就来，超放心。最满意的是卫生，每天都打扫，连角落的灰尘头发都干干净净。我订的大房有两张双人床，大宝和老公都能一起陪住，一家人整整齐齐陪我坐月子，真的太幸福了。

For my first baby I did confinement at home, getting up in the middle of every night to make bottles, feed and burp — I was worn out and low. For the second I went straight to a confinement centre, and it turned everything I'd imagined upside down: my days were eat, drink, sleep, pump, like a five-star hotel stay.

The nurses came the moment I called; if anything happened with the baby in my room, someone was there. What impressed me most was the hygiene — cleaned every day, not a speck of dust or a stray hair in any corner. The large room I booked had two double beds, so my older child and my husband could stay too. Having the whole family with me through confinement was such a happy thing.

在 Amazing，除了挤奶以外都有专业护士帮我照顾宝宝，每天主动更新宝宝的情况。贴心的爸爸餐让我们一起享受用餐时光——真正体验到 happy wife, happy baby, happy life。

房间采光很好，厕所设有暖灯不怕洗澡着凉，每个细节都让我觉得被照顾。专业课程也帮我们解决了亲喂和哺乳的困扰。很庆幸选择了 Amazing。

At Amazing the nurses looked after my baby in everything but pumping, and they updated me on how he was doing without my having to ask. The thoughtful meals for dads meant we could enjoy mealtimes together — happy wife, happy baby, happy life, exactly as they say.

The room had lovely daylight, and the warm lamp in the bathroom meant I never got cold after a shower — every detail felt like care. The classes also solved the difficulties we were having with latching and feeding. I'm so glad we chose Amazing.

第一胎经朋友推荐选了 Amazing，事实证明是很棒的决定——所以二胎我没有犹豫，直接回来了。护理师天天跟进我的情况，中医师定期咨询调养，姜汁洗头和每周按摩让身心彻底放松。

最安心的是可以用平板 24 小时连接 CCTV 看到宝宝。情绪不稳的那几天，护理师们细心陪伴和鼓励，让我觉得被理解。很建议新手爸妈来这里，边被照顾、边学会照顾宝宝。

We chose Amazing for our first baby on a friend's recommendation, and it turned out to be a wonderful decision — so the second time I didn't hesitate. My carer followed up on how I was doing every single day, the TCM physician checked in regularly, and the ginger-water hair washes and weekly massages let body and mind completely unwind.

What put me most at ease was being able to see my baby on the tablet at any hour. On the days my emotions ran high, the carers sat with me and encouraged me, and I felt understood. I'd really recommend this place to new parents — you're cared for while you learn to care for your baby.

用三个字形容 Amazing，就是“吃不停”。药膳按每位妈妈的体质定制，营养均衡、每一道都精致漂亮。在专业中医师的指导下可以安心洗头，既科学又舒适，育儿课程和手工课也让生活很精彩。

坐月子最重要的就是开心和充足休息，这些 Amazing 都做到了——五星级的环境、服务和照顾，让我安心度过这段重要时光。

Three words for Amazing: never stop eating. The herbal meals are tailored to each mother's constitution — balanced, and every dish beautifully plated. With a TCM physician's guidance I could wash my hair without worry, which felt both sensible and comfortable, and the parenting and craft classes made the days interesting.

What matters most in confinement is being happy and properly rested, and Amazing delivered both — five-star surroundings, service and care carried me through this important time.

第一次踏进 Amazing，就像走进五星级酒店。宝宝遇到黄疸也能马上获得专业帮助，窗外蓝天绿意，每次望出去都很放松。

每一餐摆盘精致又营养均衡；随时想见宝宝，护士都细心安排，医生也定期关注妈妈和宝宝。服务我给满分。宝宝能游泳、按摩，妈妈能上手工课，月子生活丰富又温暖。

Walking into Amazing for the first time felt like walking into a five-star hotel. When my baby developed jaundice, professional help was there immediately, and the blue sky and greenery outside the window relaxed me every time I looked out.

Every meal was beautifully plated and nutritionally balanced; whenever I wanted to see my baby, the nurses arranged it thoughtfully, and the doctors checked on us both regularly. Full marks for the service. My baby could swim and have massages, I could join craft classes — confinement life was full and warm.
从产后修复的角度，42 天能让身体有较完整的时间完成调理与修复；28 天则涵盖了最关键的恢复阶段，同样是许多妈妈安心的选择。若您考虑 42 天，我们会建议尽早预订——房间数量有限，日后若想延长，未必仍有空房。顾问也很乐意依您的预产期与恢复状况，陪您一起确认最合适的天数。

From a recovery point of view, 42 days gives the body a full stretch of time to be nourished and to heal; 28 days covers the most critical stage and is a choice many mothers are happy with. If you're considering 42 days, we'd suggest booking early — rooms are limited, and extending later isn't always possible. Our consultants are glad to talk it through with you, based on your due date and how your recovery is going.

生完才体会到，妈妈要一边疗伤、一边承受情绪和压力，如果没有 Amazing 的帮助，我可能真的会崩溃。

不论遇到什么问题，团队都第一时间解决；护理专业、餐食健康，加上中医师和泌乳师的支持，刚开始的焦虑慢慢消散。他们照顾过上百位新手妈妈，让我放心把自己和宝宝交给他们。

It was only after giving birth that I understood — a mother has to heal while carrying all the emotion and pressure at once. Without Amazing's help, I think I might genuinely have fallen apart.

Whatever came up, the team dealt with it straight away. The nursing was professional, the food was wholesome, and with the TCM physician and lactation consultant behind me, the anxiety of those first days slowly faded. They've cared for hundreds of first-time mothers, and I felt safe leaving myself and my baby in their hands.
成为妈妈以后，我才真正体会到，坐月子不只是休息那么简单。那段时间，我经历了身体的不适、情绪的起伏，还有对育儿的种种不安与迷茫。正因为走过那一段路，我更希望可以为其他妈妈们，打造一个「有人理解、有人照顾、有专业可以依靠」的地方。于是，Amazing 月子中心诞生了。

It was only after becoming a mother myself that I understood confinement is not simply about resting. In those weeks I went through physical discomfort, emotional ups and downs, and a great deal of uncertainty about raising a child. Because I walked that road, I wanted to build a place for other mothers — somewhere you are understood, cared for, and have real expertise to lean on. That is how Amazing was born.
在 Amazing 月子中心，我们深信专业的照护团队是产后修复的关键。我们的团队由经验丰富的月子护理师、儿科医生、母乳哺育顾问、中医调理顾问等组成，每一位成员都经过严格筛选与培训，具备母婴照护的专业背景与实战经验。

At Amazing we believe a skilled care team is the key to postnatal recovery. Ours brings together experienced confinement carers, paediatricians, breastfeeding consultants and TCM advisors — every member carefully selected and trained, with a professional background in mother-and-baby care and real experience behind them.
